$schema_note: Post-v0.4 M1 baseline wall-clock for tests/conformance/ excluding test_freddy_* and test_legacy_runtime_budget.py itself. Used by tests/conformance/test_legacy_runtime_budget.py (VAL-REGRESSION-LEGACY-BUDGET-001). Re-captured after M1 v1.1 work (cross-record, v1_1_rules, namespace_lints, validator_*, redaction integration) landed; the new tests are in tests/conformance/ but not test_freddy_*, so they fall inside the selector and account for the runtime increase over the pre-v0.4 baseline. The 10% headroom continues to enforce no future regression.
notes: Three back-to-back warm runs with `-p no:cacheprovider` were used to suppress pytest's .pytest_cache effects. min is the conservative anchor (lowest observed; future regressions are most visible against the floor).
Headroom is 10% per VAL-REGRESSION-LEGACY-BUDGET-001. Budget check: current_seconds <= baseline_for_budget_check * 1.10.
Set ACEF_SKIP_RUNTIME_BUDGET=1 to skip the gate (e.g., on busy local machines). CI is the authoritative enforcement environment.

Original pre-v0.4 baseline was 19.58s with 406 tests; post-M1 baseline is 23.345s with 425 tests. The +3.76s delta is explained by 19 new conformance tests added by M1 v1.1 work (cross_record, validator_rules, namespace_lints, redaction integration, CLI verify driver). Per-test runtime average is comparable (~55ms each).
